summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, announcing an extraordinary general meeting set for October 20, 2026 in Beijing. Shareholders will vote on an ordinary resolution to ratify a previously announced subscription by a wholly owned subsidiary for a limited partnership interest in Tianjin Lisi Xingshen Equity Investment Partnership, with a RMB1.5 billion capital commitment. The board recommends voting in favor. Record date is September 21, 2026. This is a routine EGM notice and ratification vote, not a special situation; ADS holders may instruct JPMorgan Chase as depositary. Watch for approval outcome and any related disclosure.
